facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs told the National Assembly that registered voters could inspect the provisional register online through the ECZ website or by dialling USSD *214#, and physically at all 12,152 polling stations, until 8 March 2026.

The Minister said the ECZ had deployed 2,354 Biometric Voter Registration kits nationwide and had run de-duplication and data cleansing on the provisional register of 8,861,918 voters, which was also served electronically.
